title: E-ink display subsystem (T-Echo firmware)
description: Firmware display driver and screen renderer for T-Echo 200x200 1-bit e-ink. Implements: status bar (battery, hops, time, unread, sync state), 4 primary screens (Messages, Map/Peers-nearby, Peers, Status), 2 secondary (Settings, Keys). 3-button navigation (PREV/SELECT/NEXT). Partial refresh for status bar, full refresh on screen change. Sleep after 30s, wake on button/radio. Unread badge on sleep screen. Spec: 11-lci.md §17.8.7 e-ink specifics. C/Zephyr in subsys/lichen or apps/puck.
